messages.subject: runtime error: csr_matrix_times_vector dimensions
parts:
I'm hoping there's some insider knowledge that can explain the following runtime error, but advice on how to debug is welcome too.

I'm inputting the compressed row storage data for a N by K sparse matrix directly, with data declaration

    vector[M] d_w;

    int d_v[M];

    int d_u[N + 1];


I have a parameter


    vector[K] alpha;


and my transformed parameters section includes the call


    csr_matrix_times_vector(N, K, d_w, d_v, d_u, alpha)

    

The runtime error is


    Exception thrown at line 29: csr_matrix_times_vector: u/z (11919) and v (11920) must match in size


I've confirmed with a print statement (in the transformed data section) that num_elements(d_w) and num_elements(d_u) are both 11920. I'm at a loss to figure out what u/z is or where it comes from.


I'll start cutting down my code/data to a shareable working example, but perhaps there's a quick suggestion?

messages.author: 96d1226247a75957
messages.subject: Re: runtime error: csr_matrix_times_vector dimensions
parts:
Resolved.
My array's d_v and d_u were produced in Python ... with zero-based indexing. Indexing from one eliminates the error.
